description: At Eastvale Logging Camp, Sara Timberlain stitches gear for the Stormwind Army. She makes useful armaments from salvaged cloth and leather.
intro: At Eastvale Logging Camp, Sara Timberlain stitches gear for the Stormwind Army. She makes useful armaments from salvaged cloth and leather.

p: Sara Timberlain works with needle and thread outside a small cottage on the western edge of Eastvale Logging Camp. Axes sound through the camp as workers fell trees. Though Eastvale lies far from settled lands, wolves and murlocs prowl nearby, and Sara still offers travelers hospitality. She turns scraps of linen and salvaged bandanas into sturdy gear. Her skill has earned official recognition and commissions to supply cloth and leather armaments to Stormwind's military forces.
